explication: Zapret Manager is an OpenWrt router application for managing local DPI bypass, tunnel-based routing, Telegram proxies, encrypted DNS, hosts, and router maintenance. The documented user flow is to open LuCI or the standalone Web UI, sign in if needed, then manage components and view their status. The README describes capabilities but no source excerpts were provided, so implementation links use only paths visible in the tree; documented relationships cite the README.
